title: Verification of the Thermodynamic Cyclic Rule
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify the cyclic relation (dP/dV)_T (dV/dT)_P (dT/dP)_V = -1 for the ideal gas law PV = RT.
finalAnswer: \left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial V}\right)_T \left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_P \left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial P}\right)_V = -1

steps.title: Compute Each Constrained Partial Derivative
steps.mathExpression: P = \frac{RT}{V} \implies \left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial V}\right)_T = -\frac{RT}{V^2}; \quad V = \frac{RT}{P} \implies \left(\frac{\partial V}{\partial T}\right)_P = \frac{R}{P}; \quad T = \frac{PV}{R} \implies \left(\frac{\partial T}{\partial P}\right)_V = \frac{V}{R}
steps.explanation: Solve for each variable in turn and differentiate.

steps.title: Multiply the Three Factors
steps.explanation: Cancel common factors and use PV = RT.
